limitations: Edited TBMM minutes create output-style-dependent reference bias. The historical pooled pilot diagnostic cannot justify a common WER offset or a system-ranking threshold.
Upstream ASR-agreement CER <= 0.25 filtering selects easier/aligned speech and may favour Whisper-family outputs; not a human quality guarantee.
Topic labels and relational facts are automatic lexicon matches (lexicon-screening-unverified).
Pre-2026 audio and minutes are public, so pretraining contamination of baselines cannot be excluded for train/validation; test uses only 2026 sessions.
Validation sessions can be one day from train sessions in December 2025; recording grouping does not establish speaker or topic independence.

613/636 test rows were public WorldSpeech train rows. Externally WorldSpeech-fine-tuned parents and unfiltered WorldSpeech train are prohibited; own frozen TURAS-train tuning is permitted. No test-session text in training/graph/LM/prompts.
Audio near-duplicate audit not performed; duplicate_cluster_id singleton values are placeholders. Exact hashes/groups/text checks do not prove near-duplicate absence.
The new verification plan was prepared after working test evaluation; no blind-before-all-evaluation claim.
